newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries at session lows on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries at session lows on profit-taking.

text.p: *US Treasuries at session lows on profit-taking.
*T-bond yield above 6.50 pct as participants eye Greenspan Humphrey-Hawkins testimony next week.
*Fed refrained from open market intervention, as expected.
*Dollar slides, Dow Jones average off more than 100 points.
